description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Notify the promulgate Regulations to facilitate importation/Local purchase under bonded warehouse  scheme
categorisation: This gazette content promulgates new customs regulations under the Customs Ordinance, establishing procedures and requirements for bonded warehouse facilities for specific industries. It creates a regulatory framework for importation/local purchase of capital goods with duty exemptions, which falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel or structural changes.
